items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Yeah, I worked with him. Him and I were working in that club back in West End.

ctx.x: Did you hear him play piano much by the way? Oh, yeah.

Yeah, I worked with him. Him and I were working in that club back in West End. Used to have nightclubs in West End? With the same Paul Moore. I'll tell you what. Albert was. That's where I first met Albert. He was on piano and I was on band. He worked with Paul Moore, his band back then. Back then. First time I met Albert. And he was a good piano player. He still is good, but you don't have no piano with a voice on. He was a wonderful piano player. Yeah, I hardly ever heard him play piano. He was good. Way back…
Like the one they called the Blue Angel now. Oh, yeah, yeah.
